# GeoNav — Driver & Dispatch Edition

**GeoNav** is a companion web application designed for drivers, dispatchers, and field operatives. It seamlessly decrypts encrypted location codes (generated by the **GeoCrypt - Location Encryptor** app) into precise geographic coordinates and destination details.

Featuring an iOS-inspired liquid glass UI, interactive Leaflet map integration, and one-touch external map app launching, GeoNav gets drivers moving toward encrypted targets quickly and securely.

---

## 🌟 Key Features

* **Instant Cipher Decryption**: Decodes `GEO-` encrypted location codes or raw coordinate pairs into readable address labels, latitude, longitude, and creation timestamps.
* **Target Location Map View**: Renders an interactive Leaflet map centered directly on the decrypted destination with a custom target pin marker.
* **One-Touch External Map Launching**: Deep-links directly to your choice of navigation app:
  * 🗺️ **Google Maps** (Direct route link)
  * 🍏 **Apple Maps** (Turn-by-turn guidance)
  * 🚗 **Waze App** (Traffic avoidance)
* **Dispatch Trip Log**: Stores past decrypted trips in `localStorage` for quick re-loading or review without needing to re-enter codes.
* **iOS Liquid Glass & Retro LCD Aesthetic**: Features tactile skeuomorphic controls, dark/light mode toggle, and a retro LCD display for decrypted payload metadata.
* **Zero Dependencies / Single File Deployment**: Built using pure Vanilla JavaScript, Tailwind CSS (via CDN), Phosphor Icons, and Leaflet JS—no build steps or npm packages required.

---

## 🛠️ Tech Stack

* **Frontend Framework**: Vanilla JavaScript (ES6+)
* **Styling**: [Tailwind CSS](https://tailwindcss.com/) (CDN) with custom skeuomorphic/glassmorphism CSS variables
* **Icons**: [Phosphor Icons](https://phosphoricons.com/)
* **Interactive Mapping**: [Leaflet.js](https://leafletjs.com/) with OpenStreetMap tiles
* **Data Storage**: Browser `localStorage`

---

## 🚀 Getting Started

### Prerequisites
All you need is a modern web browser (Chrome, Safari, Firefox, Edge).

### Installation & Running
1. Download or clone the file: `GeoNav - Driver Dispatch App.html`.
2. Double-click or open the `.html` file directly in your web browser.
3. No server setup, Node.js environment, or installation required!

---

## 📱 How to Use

### 1. Decrypting a Location
1. Copy a `GEO-` code generated from the **GeoCrypt** app (or tap **"Paste Clipboard"**).
2. Click **"Decrypt & Calibrate Route"**.
3. View the decrypted target address name, exact coordinates, and timestamp on the retro LCD screen.

<img width="1918" height="916" alt="Screenshot 2026-07-26 100552" src="https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/cd8e5a6d-38fd-4635-8212-29315bf00269" />

### 2. Inspecting the Target Destination
* Scroll down to view the **Interactive Location Map View**.
* Use zoom controls to inspect surrounding roads and landmarks near the pin marker.

### 3. Launching External Navigation
* Tap any of the external map service buttons (**Google Maps**, **Apple Maps**, or **Waze**).
* The selected navigation app will open with the destination coordinates pre-loaded.

### 4. Viewing Trip History
* Switch to the **Trips** tab in the bottom navigation bar to view previously decrypted location codes.
* Tap **"Load Route"** to re-inspect a past trip or click the trash icon to clear individual/all logs.

## 🔐 Cipher System Overview

GeoNav uses a symmetrical reversible decoding sequence to parse `GEO-` ciphers created by **GeoCrypt**:

```text
[ Encrypted Cipher: GEO-X9B2-41A2-K9 ]
                 │
                 ▼ (Remove GEO- prefix & dashes)
[ Raw Character String ]
                 │
                 ▼ (Character Shift & Reverse Mapping)
[ Base64 String ]
                 │
                 ▼ (Base64 Decode & Delimiter Split)
[ Latitude | Longitude | Address Label | Timestamp ]

```

| --- | --- | --- |
| **GeoCrypt** | Encryptor | Selects map points and generates `GEO-` cipher codes |
| **GeoNav** | Decryptor / Navigator | Decodes `GEO-` cipher codes and launches map navigation |
